title: Audit sync checklist + action log (1:1 prep)
content:
Purpose: quick prep for 1:1 with Ben (Audit Lead) — align on SOC2/ISO gap triage, vendor evidence, and next-week deliverables.

Meeting context (30m):
- Who: Ben (audit lead), me (security PM), optional: Jonah (platform eng if capacity questions), Kara (privacy) — keep to core for this 1:1.
- When: 2025-01-16 10:00am PT (30m)
- Goals: agree priority controls to remediate in Q1, confirm vendor evidence intake process, get signoff on compressed timeline for reassessment of two services.

Quick agenda (for meeting):
1) 5m: current readiness snapshot (high-level).
2) 10m: go/no-go list for controls we think we can close before auditor kickoff.
3) 10m: vendor evidence / attestations — who will chase what and escalation path.
4) 5m: confirm next steps + owners + deadlines.

Readiness snapshot (my notes):
- Coverage summary: access controls mostly in place; monitoring/logging has gaps for Dedicated infra; change mgmt docs need narrower scope and recent changelog export for two repos.
- Top 5 fast wins (estimate each 3–7 days):
  * Collect SSO config export + OKTA admin audit log (owner: Jonah, due: 2025-01-22).
  * Export and redact pipeline deploy history for prod services (owner: Release Eng oncall, due: 2025-01-21).
  * Vendor A (embeddings provider): get latest SOC2 or ISO cert + data flow diagram (owner: Vendor Ops — PRS-17, due: 2025-01-20).
  * Backup verification snapshot for customer DBs (owner: infra-runbooks, due: 2025-01-24).
  * Incident response tabletop notes (summarize last 6 months incidents) (owner: SRE, due: 2025-01-23).

Control-level quick status (R/Y/G shorthand):
- Access control (G): SSO and MFA enabled; need admin list export. Evidence: okta-sso-export.csv, iam-policy-v2.pdf
- Logging & monitoring (Y): centralized logs exist but long-term retention policy unclear for Dedicated customers. Evidence gaps: retention policy doc.
- Change management (Y): code review policy exists; automated change history missing for two repos (infra, serving-runtime).
- Data classification & DLP (Y): policy draft only; need inventory mapping for PII-containing datasets.
- Encryption (G): at-rest and in-transit covered for hosted; verify keys for private deployments (owner: security-infra).
- Vendor management (R): no consolidated attestations tracker; some vendors missing up-to-date reports.
- Backup & restore (Y): backup scripts exist but restore test records not centralized.
- Incident response (G): plan exists; need evidence of tabletop + followup actions.

Vendor evidence intake (notes + ask list):
- Ask Ben: can we accept vendor self-attestations for low-risk infra plugins or require third-party reports?
- Proposed intake flow: vendor-ops creates a Jira per vendor with attach field, tag sec-audit, ownership handoff to Vendor Ops for follow-up.
- Immediate vendors to prioritize: Vendor A (embeddings), Vendor C (monitoring agent), Vendor D (SaaS secrets store).
- Templates: need a short email template + checklist (attestation + last cert date + scope + change notification cadence).

Open questions for the 1:1 (my TODO to ask):
- Auditor flexibility: acceptable evidence windows — are last 12 months required or can we scope to last 6 for new services?
- Acceptance of internal screenshots vs. exported logs for certain controls?
- Risk appetite for Dedicated customers re: retention and cross-tenant telemetry?

Draft asks / scripts (one-liners I can use):
- "Ben — for low-risk third parties (no customer data access), would a signed vendor attestation be acceptable for this cycle?"
- "If we compress the timeline, what's our acceptable sample size for deployments and logs?"

Immediate follow-ups (after meeting) — action log (flattened):
- A1: Create vendor evidence tracker (spreadsheet + Jira template). Owner: me (Maya). Due: 2025-01-17.
- A2: Jonah to export OKTA admin list + last 90-day login report. Owner: Jonah. Due: 2025-01-22.
- A3: Release Eng to produce deploy history export for infra & serving-runtime repos. Owner: Release Eng. Due: 2025-01-21.
- A4: Vendor Ops to request SOC2/ISO cert from Vendor A & C; escalate if no response in 3 business days. Owner: Vendor Ops lead. Due: 2025-01-20.
- A5: SRE to run a short restore test and drop a short evidence note. Owner: SRE. Due: 2025-01-24.
- A6: Security to draft concise 'evidence readme' template that explains each artifact and mapping to control IDs. Owner: Security Docs. Due: 2025-01-19.

Notes-to-self (scratchpad):
- Bring up crosswalk doc (ISO->SOC2) — Ben likely prefers SOC2-first but confirm scope. Path: CONFLUENCE-SEC/crosswalk-iso-soc2 (link in artifacts).
- Keep meeting tight; avoid getting pulled into tech design details — escalate to separate deep-dive with Jonah.
- Mark items that need legal signoff (vendor contracts with data processing) and loop Kara.

Potential blockers to flag:
- Vendor slow responses (mitigation: escalate via CSM contacts).
- Missing logs older than retention window (mitigation: ask auditors about alternative evidence).

Reference artifacts to attach in meeting: (links below)
- Confluence crosswalk & evidence list (CONFLUENCE-SEC/crosswalk-iso-soc2)
- Jira board for SOC2 prep (JIRA-SEC-88)
- Example vendor email template (GDrive: vendors/vendor-email-template-2024.docx)
- Last tabletop notes (GDrive: incident-tabletop-2024-11-05.pdf)

Follow-up cadence:
- Quick async check-in: 48 hours after meeting to confirm owners created Jira tasks.
- Weekly sync: Friday 30m working cadence until audit kickoff.

Misc shorthand for notes:
- "evidence-readme" = doc mapping artifacts to control IDs.
- "attest-tracker" = sheet with vendor name, attestation type, expiry, owner, Jira ticket.

End of prep. Will tidy this into email summary + checklist after the 1:1 and push vendor tracker to shared drive.

-- Maya (notes)
